title: Institutional Equity Division - Senior Manager, EMEA Equity Documentation Negotiator (Mumbai)
description:
### **EMEA Equity Documentation( ISDA) , Institutional Equity Division**

### **This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the EMEA Equity Documentation Group based in London. The role will require a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active, and self\-motivated person to assist the team in its day\-to\-day activities.**

### **The current opening is for a professional within the EMEA team, based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock\-lending transactions in the EMEA region.**

### **Global Capital Markets:** **In the Global Capital Markets division, we offer Global expertise in market analysis and in advisory and capital\-raising services for corporations, institutions, and governments**

### **From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.**

### **Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.**

### **Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.**

### **Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.**

### **What you’ll do in the role:**

* ### **Manage the team of lawyers on the ground, co\-ordinate with stakeholder on team dynamics, work management and allocations. Grooming/ training of team**
* ### **Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.**
* ### **Review and analyze constitutional documents of the client, to establish their capacity and authority capabilities for entering derivative transactions with Morgan Stanley.**
* ### **Review and analyze capacity and authority legal opinion from external counsel and highlight issues to Risk and Legal for approvals where applicable.**
* ### **Work closely with MS internal stakeholders, to obtain approvals on deviated terms identified in negotiable agreements, with clear implication on deviated terms to enable internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.**
* ### **Handle business unit’s queries on the terms of documentation ISD handles.**
* ### **Participate in globally or locally led projects related to documentation requirements.**
* ### **Undertake tasks directly related to the coordination and lifecycle management of the clients’ agreements and act as the primary point of contact for the clients for all tasks originating from the Asia Pacific region.**
* ### **Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day\-to\-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.**

### **What you’ll bring to the role:**

* ### **Law graduate with relevant 8\-11 years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred. Legal qualification is advantageous.**
* ### **Experience in team management will be preferred.**
* ### **In\-house documentation negotiation experience or paralegal experience in corporate law firm is preferred.**
* ### **Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.**
* ### **Proficiency in English is a must. Good team player with potential to lead a team.**
* ### **Solid quantitative skills and strong interest in business, economics, and law.**
* ### **Willingness and ability to provide quality service to the Firm's clients and to promote and enhance the Firm franchise.**
* ### **Willingness to work in dynamic environment and the ability to excel under pressure.**
* ### **Proficiency and interest in technology and systems development.**
* ### **Organized, pro\-active, ability to multi\-task and work efficiently, detail\-oriented, and self\-sufficient.**

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.


To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.


Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.


Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.


For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo .

title: Medical Writer
description:
Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences is a remote\-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.


If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the Medical Writer role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.


Job responsibilities:
* Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data\-check) high\-quality, client\-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.
* Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas \- learning to anticipate their needs.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
* Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting\-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.


\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* 1\-3 years of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Should have experience working on publications.
* Experience working on gastric cancer publications would be preferable.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Excellent communication skills, especially with the clients.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process will include two **Technical Interviews** with the Hiring Managers, and a **Technical Assessment,** where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the **HR Interview.** All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams.**

 **Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 **AI at Cactus Life Sciences**


The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.


 AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.


 We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.


You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

  


About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.


Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: Technical writer.
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

 **Job Summary**

**The Technical Writer is responsible for converting, migrating, formatting, and maintaining technical documentation from legacy formats, primarily PDF documents and, where applicable, Adobe FrameMaker source files, into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines. The role involves ensuring document accuracy, formatting consistency, content integrity, and compliance with established documentation requirements. The Technical Writer will support documentation modernization initiatives and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality technical publications.**

 **Minimum Requirements**


A successful candidate will have:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Technical Writing, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution, OR equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of five (5\) years of experience in technical writing, document conversion, content migration, or technical documentation management.
* Strong command of the English language, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and accurately.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Word, including styles, templates, section breaks, page layouts, tables, captions, headers and footers, cross\-references, and document formatting.
* Experience working with PDF\-based technical documentation.
* Experience converting and formatting technical documents in Microsoft Word while maintaining content accuracy and consistency.
* Basic familiarity with Adobe FrameMaker is desirable but not mandatory.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, SnagIt, or similar documentation tools.
* Proficiency in Simplified Technical English (STE) is desirable.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, wiring diagrams, and schematic diagrams.
* Experience collaborating with SMEs to validate technical content and resolve documentation issues.
* Experience working effectively in global teams with flexible schedules.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve document formatting and content issues.
* Fundamental project management skills, including the ability to manage priorities and meet established deadlines.

**Responsibilities**


* Migrating and converting technical documentation from PDF and, where required, Adobe FrameMaker formats into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines.
* Applying approved Baker Hughes document templates, formatting standards, branding requirements, and style conventions to all converted documents.
* Preserving document structure, formatting, tables, images, captions, numbering schemes, headers and footers, and technical content during the conversion process.
* Reviewing converted documents to identify and correct formatting inconsistencies, layout issues, broken references, and content discrepancies.
* Standardizing document formatting and structure to ensure consistency across technical manuals, procedures, forms, and supporting documentation.
* Performing quality assurance reviews to ensure documentation accuracy, completeness, usability, and compliance with established standards.
* Collaborating with SMEs, reviewers, and stakeholders to validate technical content and resolve documentation\-related issues.
* Creating, updating, and maintaining technical manuals, service procedures, work instructions, forms, and related technical publications.
* Editing and optimizing graphics, screenshots, and visual content using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, SnagIt, or similar tools.
* Interpreting engineering drawings, BOMs, wiring diagrams, and schematic diagrams to support document updates and validation activities.
* Supporting documentation modernization and standardization initiatives through the migration of legacy content into approved Microsoft Word formats.
* Maintaining document repositories and ensuring version control, consistency, and traceability of documentation updates.
* Identifying opportunities to improve document quality, conversion processes, and documentation workflows.
* Managing assigned documentation deliverables in accordance with project schedules, priorities, and quality expectations.
* Focusing on technical accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement of documentation deliverables and processes.

title: Content Writer - SEO/AEO/GEO
description:
**We are looking for a creative, research\-oriented, and detail\-driven Content Writer to join our team and work on content initiatives for LG Home Comfort. The ideal candidate will have strong writing and storytelling skills, an understanding of digital content and SEO, and the ability to create engaging content for different audiences and platforms. The candidate will be responsible for developing content that communicates product features, benefits, innovations, lifestyle solutions, and brand messaging in a clear and compelling manner. This role requires someone who can understand consumer needs, translate product and technical information into easy\-to\-understand content, and maintain a consistent brand voice across digital platforms.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Content Creation:** **Write blogs, website content, product descriptions, landing pages, social media posts, campaign copies, and digital content.**
* **Content Strategy:** **Develop content calendars and ideas based on campaigns, seasons, promotions, consumer needs, and industry trends.**
* **SEO:** **Conduct keyword research and create SEO\-friendly content, including optimizing headings, meta titles, descriptions, URLs, and website copy.**
* **Social Media:** **Create platform\-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc., including captions and campaign messaging.**
* **Product Research:** **Research LG products, technologies, competitors, consumer trends, and the home\-comfort industry while ensuring factual accuracy.**
* **Editing \& Quality:** **Proofread and edit content for grammar, readability, consistency, accuracy, and brand tone.**
* **Collaboration:** **Work with marketing, SEO, design, product, social media, developers, agencies, and other stakeholders.**
* **Project Management:** **Handle multiple content projects, incorporate feedback, and deliver high\-quality work within deadlines.**

title: Content Writer
description:
**Content Writer**

Do you swear by your flair for writing? If so, we are interested! If you're ready to unleash your technical expertise and creative flair, we have the perfect opportunity for you! Our Content Writer job openings in Pune are on the hunt for eloquent wordsmiths like you.

If you're confident in your writing skills and ready to take on this exciting challenge, we want to hear from you. Share your outstanding write\-ups with us, and don't forget to attach your resume!

**About The Job:** 

**Experience**\- 1\+ Years  
**Job Location** \- Pune.(on\-Site Job)  
**Job Category**\- Web Content Writing.  
**Schedule**\- Full Time.

As Hats\-Off, we are your potential destination that ends your Content Writer job quest. We are seeking a talented and creative Content Writer to join our team. As a Content Writer, you will be responsible for producing engaging, informative, and high\-quality content across various platforms. Your role will involve researching, writing, and editing content that resonates with our target audience and aligns with our brand's voice and objectives.

**Role Summary**

* **Content Creation**: Produce well\-researched, original, and engaging content for various mediums such as blog posts, articles, social media, website copy, emails, and more. Collaborate with subject matter experts to gather information and insights for accurate and insightful content creation. Develop content that aligns with the brand's tone, style, and messaging guidelines.
* **Research**: Conduct thorough research on industry trends, topics, and keywords to create content that is relevant and up\-to\-date. Source credible information from reputable sources to ensure the accuracy and credibility of content.
* **Editing and Proofreading**: Review and edit content to ensure proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, and consistency. Strive for clarity and coherence in written content, making it easy for readers to understand and engage with.
* **Content Strategy**: Work with the content team to contribute ideas and insights to the overall content strategy. Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate fresh and innovative content ideas.
* **SEO Optimization**: Incorporate relevant keywords and SEO best practices to improve content visibility and search engine rankings. Stay updated on SEO trends and apply them to content creation.

**What's on the platter for you?**

Put an end to a relentless night in search of a Content Writer job; Embark on a Journey with us! Calling all wordsmiths, storytellers, and content champions! We're not your run\-of\-the\-mill employer; we're a powerhouse of creative minds, weaving exceptional narratives and crafting captivating messages. If you've got the potential to pen down your thoughts creatively, here's what we have to offer you:

* Limitless Creative Growth
* Continuous Learning
* Nurturing Your Growth from Novice to Expert.
* Content Excellence

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
